headline: Antonelli is F1's youngest-ever champion at 20 as Verstappen wins a chaotic Mexico City race, while AI stocks nurse a $5 trillion bruise ahead of Apple's results tonight.

upcoming.what: UFC Vegas: Cortes Acosta vs Walker. Prelims 22:00, main card 01:00 Sun Irish time. Davey Grant (England) is on the main card
F1 São Paulo GP, 17:00 Irish time, and the WEC season finale, 6 Hours of Monza, on the same day
Starship Flight 15 pencilled in for the 12th if the FAA grants a permit; ULA Vulcan return-to-flight on the 13th
UFC 334, Madison Square Garden: Gane vs Hokit for the heavyweight title, plus Harrison vs Nunes (main card early Sun 15 Nov Irish time)
GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S

items.headline: Antonelli seals the title in Mexico, the youngest F1 champion ever
items.summary: He needed ninth or better and took third, winning the crown at 20 and becoming Italy's first champion since Ascari in 1953. Sebastian Vettel's old mark, set at 23, is comfortably gone.

items.headline: Verstappen beats Hamilton by 0.8s as Ferrari fights itself
items.summary: Hamilton and Leclerc ran each other wide from the start, letting Verstappen through; Leclerc took a five-second penalty and finished fourth while Hamilton complained on the radio about being pushed out by his own teammate. Bottas's suspension failure and heavy crash then brought a red flag and a standing restart.

items.headline: Late penalties reshuffle the points, Hirakawa profits on debut
items.summary: A wave of post-race penalties lifted Haas stand-in Ryo Hirakawa from 13th to 10th in his first Grand Prix. The fight for second in the standings is now tight, with SI's post-race table showing Verstappen on 261 and Hamilton on 259; next stop is São Paulo on Sunday.

items.headline: WEC decides its season at Monza on Sunday
items.summary: Toyota's #8 crew (Buemi, Hartley, Hirakawa) lead the Hypercar table 114–97 over the sister #7 after a Barcelona one-two. LMGT3 is closer, with Jonny Edgar on 92 and Nicky Catsburg on 88.

items.headline: The AI rout now totals about $5 trillion
items.summary: Yahoo Finance calculates that 47 AI and chip stocks have lost that much since 6 October, with Nvidia and Alphabet down about $834bn each, while other large US stocks gained around $1.3tn. Apple ended Friday worth more than Nvidia, at roughly $5.03tn to $4.93tn.

items.headline: Apple and Palantir report tonight, AMD tomorrow
items.summary: Apple and Palantir publish results after the US close today, with iPhone 18 demand the focus for Apple. AMD and Super Micro follow on Tuesday, giving the AI trade its next test.

items.headline: Falcon 9 flies a classified Space Force mission overnight
items.summary: USSF-432 lifts off from Vandenberg in a four-hour window opening about 01:42 Irish time on Tuesday, with a backup a day later. The payload and orbit are undisclosed, and the booster is on its eighth flight.

items.headline: Tonight's sky: Moon, Mars and Jupiter in a line
items.summary: They rise together in the east around midnight tonight into tomorrow, and the Southern Taurids peak on 4–5 November at about five meteors an hour. Mars and Jupiter close to about a degree apart before dawn on 14–16 November.

items.headline: A 'forgotten' neutrino might help explain why matter exists
items.summary: Southampton and IIT Kanpur physicists propose that a long-ignored heavy neutrino could have briefly dominated the early universe, helping matter outlast antimatter. It is theory for now, though they suggest it could leave traces in primordial gravitational waves.

items.headline: Witcher 3 Remastered gets an AI-built hunting mod
items.summary: A modder used vibe coding to add Red Dead Redemption 2-style hunting to the remaster. It's a community project, and there's nothing new from CD Projekt on Songs of the Past or The Witcher 4.

items.headline: PS5 owners can now try a Steam Machine-style Linux setup
items.summary: A new Linux project lets a PS5 behave a bit like Valve's box, though TechRadar's advice is not to bother. It's a curiosity while the big release calendar builds towards GTA 6 on the 19th.

items.headline: Goodman retains her European No-Gi title with an 11-0 final
items.summary: Injana Goodman beat Amanda Schurtz in the women's middleweight final in Rome on Sunday, according to MiddleEasy. That is one source only, and I couldn't confirm the other black-belt or absolute results this morning, so a fuller recap may follow.

items.headline: Saturday's UFC card has a new heavyweight headliner
items.summary: Sean Brady's injury scrapped his main event with Bonfim, so Waldo Cortes Acosta and Johnny Walker now top the Vegas card. England's Davey Grant faces Elijah Smith on the main card, with no Irish fighters listed.

items.headline: Whittaker gets a home fight in Sydney
items.summary: Robert Whittaker meets Bogdan Guskov at light heavyweight in the co-main on 6 February, his first fight at home since 2014. Quillan Salkilld vs Benoit Saint Denis headlines.

items.headline: Cage Warriors 212 hits London on Saturday
items.summary: The Spanish-themed card starts at 19:00 at Television Centre, with Manuel Del Valle vs Luan Duarte on top. Englishmen Shahram Hotak and Omar Sargent are on the bill so far, and the card is still being filled.
